item.title: Saudi Arabia: Hajj Ministry Suspends Contracts With 1,800 Erring Foreign Umrah Travel Agencies
item.description: The Ministry of Hajj and Umrah announced the suspension of existing contracts with 1,800 foreign travel agencies for committing violations. item.title: Genesis Skorpio Concept: A New Frontier for Luxury Off-Roading in the UAE
item.description: Genesis officially entered the extreme off-road scene this week with the global debut of the X Skorpio Concept. Unveiled against the striking backdrop of the Rub’ al Khali, or Empty Quarter, in the United Arab Emirates, this vehicle marks the brand’s first venture into high-performance desert exploration. This launch represents a strategic change for the Korean luxury brand as it aims to blend its signature Athletic Elegance with the tough requirements of desert motorsport and active lifestyles.
